name: Industrial Flame Weapon
body:
School transmutation (fire); Level machinesmith 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of lamp oil)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one melee weapon touched
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell attaches to a weapon a mechanism that continually coats and ignites its cutting or impact edge with fiery oil. Each time this weapon hits, it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. A target that takes fire damage from this spell must succeed on a Reflex save or catch on fire.
